operation.x-minlength-note: `minLength` was REMOVED as unreachable: no single character matches this pattern, checked over every code point below U+2100, so no instance can distinguish this schema from one without it. Keeping a constraint nothing can exercise inflates every coverage number that counts it and reads as a defence it is not.

payload_hash.x-algorithm-note: The baseline says "payload hash" and names no algorithm for CTR-IDM-001. The algorithm-prefixed form is required so the algorithm is explicit on the wire and can be migrated; the algorithm itself is NOT pinned here, because choosing it is a Security decision. sprint-0a-stripe-billing-contract-th.md line 284 uses payload_sha256 for the Stripe inbox, which is cited as PRECEDENT for the shape, not as authority for CTR-IDM-001.

result_ref.x-reference-rule: Allow-listed scheme AND constrained body. An earlier version allow-listed only the scheme while the body permitted `.` and `/` freely, so independent security review passed result:../../../etc/passwd, status:/proc/self/environ, content:/.env and content://attacker.example.invalid/exfil. A leading slash, any `..` segment, and an empty segment are now all rejected. The scheme list is closed; the body is a path of dot-separated identifier segments and nothing else. The two negative lookaheads were removed: a 400,000-string fuzz by independent testing found zero divergence from this lookahead-free form, because the body grammar already forbids a leading slash, an empty segment and a `..` segment. Removing them closes WP-0A-CON-002 review finding R8 (RE2 portability) at zero cost, which had no recorded disposition anywhere.
